content: उपनयः .²1 Bringing near, fetching. .²2 Gaining, attaining, procuring. नान्यं तवाङ्घ्रपुपनयादपवर्गमूर्तेः क्षेमं जनस्य परितो भिय ईश विद्मः <ls>Bhāg. 12. 8. 43</ls>. .²3 Employing .²4 Investiture with the sacred thread, initiation into sacred study, handing a youth of the first three castes to a teacher; गृह्योक्तकर्मणा येन समीपं नीयते गुरोः . बालो वेदाय तद्योगात् बालस्योपनयं विदुः .. [By this ceremony spiritual birth is conferred upon the youth, and he becomes a द्विजन्मन्; the ages at which the ceremony may be performed by the three castes are respectively 8-16, 11-22 and 12-24; (see <ls>Ms. 2. 36-38</ls>; of what materials <ab>&c.</ab> the cords should be, is mentioned in 2. 41-46)]. .²5 The fourth member of the five-membered Indian syllogism (in logic), the application to the special case in question; व्याप्तिविशिष्टस्य हेतोः पक्षधर्मताप्रतिपादकं वचनमुपनयः <ls>Tarka K.</ls> .²6 Introduction, initiation (into any science); see next.
